name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Rios goes with exactly two of Helix, Ceres, and Regolith.
Ceres does not go with 9 ly if and only if Okafor goes with Drift.
The colonist in the Drift module's distance is higher than both Rios and the colonist studying Diatoms.
Okafor's distance is at least 2 ly more than the colonist from Venus.
Between Rios and 9 ly, one goes with Helix and the other with Callisto.
